34973: Tsukimi is an otaku girl who lives in Tokyo and wants to be an illustrator. Influenced by her late mother, she has a love for all kinds of jellyfish and is quite knowledgeable about them. She is the only resident of Amamizukan who knows Kuranosuke's true gender.
35168: Jiji is one of the Amars who is obsessed with mature, old men.
35473: Chieko is one of the Amars who is the the manager of Amamizukan. She is obsessed with dressing in traditional Japanese clothes, such as in a kimono, and collects traditional Japanese dolls.
35474: Mayaya is one of the Amars who is obsessed with Records of Three Kingdoms.
35475: Banba is one of the Amars who is obsessed with all kinds of trains. Her 'afro' hair is actually a natural perm.
35476: Kuranosuke is the son of a rich political family. He uses the alias "Kurako" in front of the other Amars to hide his gender. He enjoys cross-dressing, to the chagrin of his family.
35477: Shuu is Kuranosuke's half-brother and a personal assistant to their father. Due to catching his father cheating with Kuranosuke's mother at a young age, he has a phobia of women.
35478: He is the driver for the Koibuchi family. Loves his car to the point it can be used as leverage against him.
37411: Tsukimi's mother, who died from an illness when Tsukimi was a little girl.
38111: Tsukimi's pet jellyfish, who sometimes goes into "explanation mode".
38201: A landmark developer who plans to turn the Amamizukan into a high rise hotel. In order to achieve support, she manipulates Shuu and makes him believe they had sex so she can blackmail him into getting in good relations with his father.
38202: Shuu and Kuranosuke's father, whose delivery is nearly always deadpan.
60109: Chiyoko is Chieko's mother. She is the owner of Amamizukan, but is rarely present as she is a groupie of Korean actor Bae Yong Joon and often travels to Korea just to see him. She decides to sell Amamizukan and use the money to move to Korea permanently and study the language.
